title: BaseLocalizationCohomologyIsIso
statement: For commutative rings R, Rp, A, B, D with R to Rp a localization at S, compatible R and Rp algebra structures on A and B, tensor coefficient maps to D, and derived categories, let Q be any A-cochain complex and L, K the base-derived tensor cohomology models over R and Rp. In every degree i the canonical B-linear baseLocalizationCohomologyMap of [lem-pc-base-localization-map] is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0DJ8, lemma-single-complex-base-change-condition, affine displayed localization identity; More on Algebra Tag 06Y6

proof.text: Restriction of a K-flat Rp-complex to R is K-flat by lem-pc-localization-restriction-kflat. The existing scalarExtension_quasiIso_of_kFlat supplies PreservesKFlatQuasiIso for extension to B over either base. ModuleCat has functorial flat resolutions and exact countable colimits, so the source-library characterization isLeftDerivedFunctor_iff_isIso_app_of_kFlat applies. Applied to L.universal it makes L.counit invertible at each restricted K-flat complex.

The counit baseLocalizationCounit at a K-flat Rp-complex is a composite of associators, the restriction derived-category factor isomorphism mapped by L.derived, L.counit at the restricted complex, and the ordinary localization tensor isomorphism mapped by Qh. All factors are invertible. NatTrans.isIso_app_iff_of_iso transports the counit component along mapHomotopyCategoryFactors. Apply the K-flat universal characterization over Rp: restriction.mapDerivedCategory followed by L.derived is a left derived functor with this counit.

Apply Mathlib Functor.isLeftDerivedFunctor_iff_isIso_leftDerivedLift to K.universal and the universal counit just proved. This makes the entire natural transformation baseLocalizationDerivedMap an isomorphism. In baseLocalizationCohomologyMap, the model cohomology isomorphisms, the image of the input isomorphism under L.derived, the component of this lift, and their image under B-homology are all isomorphisms. The composite is therefore an isomorphism in every degree.

R4 Lean proof uses the K-flat counit characterization and uniqueness of universal derived functors directly, without choosing another resolution.

Derived tensor product commutes with localization of the base ring
